About Willrich
Willrich Precision offers over 50 years of experience in the field of Gaging, Inspection & Metrology. Our product offering includes basic measuring tools up to the most sophisticated metrology products.
We are ISO:9001:2015 certified for the Distribution of Measurement & Gaging Equipment & ISO/IEC 17025:2017 accredited for on-site calibrations services for Optical Comparators, Video Measuring Systems, Hardness Testers, Surface Plates & Force Testers. We also offer Calibration services of various gages and measurement equipment available through our partnering ISO:17025 Labs.
